scientific_goal: Probe short-term behavioral path dependence in host choice; not multi-generational or evolutionary hysteresis.

source.article: Haan et al. (2021), Scientific Reports, doi:10.1038/s41598-020-80413-y

ecology.prior_art: Original publication already finds temporal changes in oviposition preference; do not claim that discovering temporal association itself is novel.

eligibility.sequential_trial: a current row with at least one Plantago and at least one Castilleja offered, current recorded host eggs >0, and a preceding egg-producing trial in the same matriline
eligibility.label: 1 if Plantago receives strictly more eggs than both Castilleja species combined in the current mixed-offer trial, else 0
eligibility.ties_and_other_eggs: Plantago strictly exceeds native total; other eggs excluded from binary label; test sensitivity exclusion if other eggs are nonzero

prediction.incremental_feature: Plantago egg share of all named-host eggs on the immediately preceding egg-positive trial in the same matriline (not plant availability on that trial)
prediction.model: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=2000, solver=lbfgs, no hyperparameter tuning)
prediction.validation: Leave-one-matriline-out; held-out score calculated on eligible trials, prior behavioral observation available chronologically
prediction.primary_statistic: mean held-out baseline log loss minus history-augmented log loss, unweighted per trial
prediction.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap resampling matrilines (2000 draws, fixed seed 20261010), not individual eggs
prediction.secondary: Brier skill difference and host-choice class balance
prediction.negative_control: On rows with a next egg-positive trial, replace lag feature with next-trial Plantago share; future-choice predictive skill as stable-matriline/trait confounding diagnostic only. It is not a valid prospective model.

claim_gate.positive_pilot: primary held-out improvement >0 with matriline bootstrap 95% interval excluding 0, plus the past-choice predictor exceeding future-choice diagnostic on identical rows, and effect not concentrated in one matriline
claim_gate.if_not_passed: no evidence for predictive behavioral carryover under this exploratory design
claim_gate.even_if_passed: association only: cannot attribute to memory, evolution, historical exotic-host exposure, or demographic trapping
claim_gate.next_step: experimental controlled host-sequence exposure, balanced mothers/populations, plus subsequent oviposition and offspring adult emergence after controlled host loss

stop: Unclear identity of matriline/trials or .cl meaning: treat interpretation as provisional
Too few eligible groups/events: report nonestimable
No rearing cohort or host-removal variable: do not estimate adult recruitment/fallback
Original paper already documented temporal preference: do not rebrand as new scientific discovery
